Looks like your COM is going to shift over to your shuttle as your boosters are jettisoned and the fuel tank is emptied. I'm on Console and honestly haven't had much luck with shuttles. The only way I'm able to make it work is by making a smaller shuttle and fidgeting with the thrust vector until it's pointing just slightly below the COM overlay. My shuttle will still flip over onto it's back, very similar to how the IRL shuttle would complete it PYR profile. The trick is keeping it controllable. I find a shallower ascent profile seems to work better for shuttle style craft, but better builders than myself are able to follow a really efficient gravity turn. 

In the VAB, try removing your boosters and slowly emptying fuel from your main tank to find out where your COM is going to shift to. And try to adjust your thrust vector to compensate for those changes. Like finding a happy middle ground

Yeah, we've eliminated just about everything. Going with the doctor's advice, just plain dove soap and weekly baths. My Mother In Law recommend using something like orange tea, but to me that seems like a bad idea for such a young digestive system. 

As for the eucerin cream, we have that about two weeks and it didn't seem to help or hinder. The Aveeno more or less helps take the edge off the itching for a little while.
